---

Welcome to the **Sprang Lab** — the BioAI group at Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz. This is where we share our research, code, and ideas in computational biology.

The blog is written by the whole group. Lab members, external students, and alumni are welcome to post about their work, for example a recent paper or a finished thesis, either on their own or together with me. The workflow is simple:

1. Fork the repository
2. Create a new folder under `blog/posts/` named `YYYY-MM-DD-your-title/`
3. Write your post as `index.qmd`
4. Open a pull request

We look forward to sharing our work here. Stay tuned!
